docs.text: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that lets AI models securely connect to external data sources, tools, and development environments. An MCP server exposes tools, resources, and prompt templates over a standard JSON-RPC interface, so any compatible client can discover and call them without custom glue code.
docs.title: MCP Overview

docs.text: Tool calling is how an agent acts on the world: the model decides which tool to invoke, the client executes it, and the result is fed back into the model's context. This loop repeats until the model has enough evidence to answer. Guardrails matter: tools should be allow-listed, arguments validated, and side effects kept explicit and reversible where possible.
docs.title: Tool Calling in Agents
